title: Three Values to Zero
summary: Find unique triples whose sum is zero.
statement: Return every unique sorted triple of values from distinct indices that sums to zero. Result order does not matter.
hints: Sorting exposes useful order and makes duplicates adjacent.
Fix one number, then search the suffix with two pointers.
Move left for a small sum and right for a large sum; skip repeated values.
Sorting plus an outer loop and inner two-pointer scan gives O(n²).
editorial: Sort the values, fix each distinct first value, and use two pointers to find complementary pairs while skipping duplicates.

tests.explanation: Two distinct value triplets sum to zero; duplicate triplets are omitted.
No three values sum to zero, so the result is empty.
